task: 2d Task 5b -- the difficulty rung on field construction version 2, and the conditioning discriminator that runs before it
what_this_rung_is_and_is_not: It is ONE rung on the corrected builder, read against the three shipped rungs' null on
signal-free fields. It is NOT a sweep: `parameters = factor x BASE` holds white/sigma constant
and amplitude is free under a concentrated likelihood, so a rung sweep moves a quantity the fit
cannot see -- filed at E5 and unchanged by the repair.
IT IS NOT A NEW RUNG NAME. The lever is the SIGNAL and the signal is FIXED for every field, so
what distinguishes this measurement from the easy rung's is the CONSTRUCTION VERSION, not a
different (coherence_length, contrast). A new rung carrying the easy rung's own parameters
would be a second spelling of it -- (j9) -- and would produce a byte-identical field under a
different name. The construction version is the better identifier because it names what
actually differs, and it is in the instrument block.
It quotes no magnitude about the ocean. Its field is simulated and its parameters are ours.
the_fixture_fact_that_would_void_everyth: If version 1 stops rebuilding bit-identically, the three-rung null loses its subject and this
rung has nothing to be read against. The byte guard is the check and it is run BEFORE this,
not after -- a guard run afterwards is a guard fitted to the outcome.

instrument.field: fields.build_field at construction version 2, rung `easy`'s parameters, seed fields.FIELD_SEED, geometry 32 x 12, n_time 630
instrument.signal: trend only, rise over the record = 16 x THAT CELL's sigma, added after the draw
instrument.fit: the shipped `fit`, candidates fields.CANDIDATES (M = 3), criteria fields.CRITERIA
instrument.arms: the shipped ARMS, interleaved within one session, never compared across sessions
instrument.host_gate: the quiet check GATES the run and does not annotate it

cost_basis.fixture_named: 2d's own parameters at fields.BASE, 16 points, both families, N = 630, M = 3, shipped fit
note: A rate is a measurement of a WORKLOAD -- (j8)'s second register -- so the fixture is named
beside the number. Iterations are the reproducible unit and seconds are the money; the
budget is in seconds and the conversion is late.

readings.name: the conditioning discriminator -- outcome distribution, version 1 against version 2, interleaved
why_it_exists: The signal does TWO things and only one was predicted: it raises iterations, and on the
small fixture it improved convergence from 93/96 to 96/96. So a null at 43.94 has two
readings -- no hysteresis at 2c's difficulty, or a better-conditioned field that suppresses
hysteresis independently of iteration count -- and the pre-decided stop is written as though
only the first existed. This reading is what tells them apart, and it FIRES rather than
why_it_is_a_separate_probe_and_not_a_col: The rung runs version 2 ALONE. No amount of recording inside it can compare two
constructions, because the other one is not there. The comparison needs both, interleaved in
one session, which is a probe. It also costs about 11 minutes against the rung's 13.2 h, so
it runs FIRST: if conditioning has materially moved, the rung's stop clause is known to be
confounded before the 13 hours are spent rather than inside its report.
readings.quantity: fraction of fitted cells whose outcome is not OK, version 1 minus version 2, on the same 16 points at N = 630
readings.form: a BAND, because there is no ordering to extend -- version 2 could condition better or worse and both are findings
expected_value_determined_by: An argument, not an observation. The trend is one column of the design matrix and is
projected out of the concentrated likelihood, so the curvature in the covariance parameters
should be essentially unchanged; what moves is the path, not the geometry of the optimum.
The small-fixture observation (3 of 96 cells, at n_time = 48) is inside this band and is
what raised the question rather than what sets its width.

reading: Conditioning has materially moved, so a null on this field is CONFOUNDED: it could be the
absence of hysteresis or the absence of anything to be hysteretic about. THE PRE-DECIDED
STOP IS SUSPENDED and the rung's null, if it comes, is reported as two candidate readings
rather than one conclusion. This is the clause that makes the stop honest.

readings.name: the conditioning discriminator -- Hessian condition number
readings.quantity: median log10 of FitResult.hessian_cond over OK fits, version 2 minus version 1, same points
readings.form: a BAND, for the same reason as C1
expected_value_determined_by: The same argument as C1: an exactly absorbed column changes the profile, not the curvature
of the parameters that remain. Half a decade is the width at which a shift stops being
arithmetic and starts being a different optimisation problem.
NaN means UNDEFINED and has two causes -- no Hessian, or one that is not positive definite --
so NaN fits are COUNTED and reported, never dropped into the median.

refuted_from_either_side.when: |difference| > 0.5 decades, or the NaN count differs by more than 0.05 of fits
refuted_from_either_side.reading: Same as C1: the stop is suspended and the null is reported as two readings.

readings.name: the rung's difficulty, stated against 43.94 and not against 40.79
readings.quantity: cold iterations per point over the field
the_target_has_two_referents_and_this_na: THE STOP IS AGAINST 43.94 -- 2c's fixture as the SHIPPED fit measures it, which is the only
condition under which the comparison is like-for-like, because this rung runs on the shipped
40.79 IS NOT DELETED AND IS NOT THE TARGET: it is 2c's own reading on its own optimizer path.
The two are different instruments on one fixture -- (j5) -- and the gap between them is a
recorded fact about the two, not a discrepancy to reconcile.
Per-point iterations are comparable only at equal M. Both readings are at M = 3, so this
comparison is safe; it was not before the candidate set grew from two to three.
expected_value_determined_by: The 16-point probe measured 43.50 for this construction at fields.BASE. The field's factor
runs 0.5 to 3.0, and per-cell scaling holds rise/sigma at 16 everywhere, so the only quantity
that varies across the field is rho in samples -- worth about one iteration across a factor
of 6.7. The band is the probe's value plus that variation and the between-point spread.

reading: The per-cell scaling did not deliver the uniform difficulty it was chosen for, so the field
is not at 2c's difficulty and the stop does not apply at all.
The field is harder than the construction predicts, which would mean the signal is doing
something beyond the term it names -- the version 2 difference test asserts it is not, so
this firing is a contradiction between two instruments and is reported as one.

readings.name: the interior null -- the gate, read first as at every rung
prediction_is_cited_not_restated: Task 2 committed this before any rung ran and it is NOT re-predicted here: it does not fire.
_family() is a pure indicator, so the true family is constant within a regime and a
misclassification profile has no slope to find. A measurement stated twice has one copy
note_at_a_raised_baseline: The baseline is measured at 0.062 with the signal and 0.062 without, so the profile is the
primary reading and the width is secondary -- a smear must push a row past 0.5 to register as
a width at all, and at this baseline that is a large flip. WidthReading.profile travels with
every reading so a band that never crosses a half is still visible.

readings.name: the saving and the width -- an ordering, with a floor
readings.form: an ordering, because one is predicted: the saving is the cheaper signal and moves first
readings.predicted: the saving rises toward 2c's range AND a width appears above the 1-cell floor, in that order

refuted_from_below.when: warm equals cold at every index, at R1's difficulty, with C1 and C2 inside their bands
refuted_from_below.reading: THE PRE-DECIDED STOP. No further rungs. See the prepared conclusion below.

refuted_from_above.when: a width exceeding one coarse spacing (8 fine cells)
reading: Points are misclassifying on their own side of the boundary, so the profile is reading
something other than cross-boundary contamination and the estimator's subject is not what

readings.name: the rung's own outcome distribution, recorded alongside iterations
readings.quantity: fraction of fitted cells whose outcome is not OK, on the rung itself, per arm
why: C1 measures 16 points; the rung measures 384 across both regimes. This is the in-situ check
that the probe's discriminator describes the run it was used to interpret.
readings.form: a band around the probe's version 2 arm

reading: The probe does not describe the rung -- most likely because 16 points at fields.BASE do not
represent a field whose factor runs 0.5 to 3.0 -- and the confound question is REOPENED on
the rung's own numbers rather than closed by the probe's.

readings.name: the artifact can name its own field
required: The rung's artifact records the SEED and the FIELD CONSTRUCTION VERSION, with its instrument
Criterion 17's artifacts record geometry, candidates and signal terms and cannot name their
own field -- their numbers are rebuildable only from a harness literal. The version marker
does not fix that for them, and this rung must not inherit it on day one.

the_prepared_conclusion_if_the_stop_fire: Written now so it is a prepared reading and not an improvised one.
If no artifact appears at 43.94 with conditioning comparable to version 1's, that is the
pre-decided stop, and it is a LARGER finding than a width would have been: no hysteresis at
2c's own difficulty, on a field carrying what 2c's carried, measured on the shipped mechanism.
It puts two things side by side and asks what connects them: D1's 42.28% saving, and the
absence of any artifact at the difficulty where that saving was measured. A warm start that
saves 42.28% of iterations while moving no selected candidate anywhere is buying TIME and not
BIAS -- which is the good case for warm-starting, and the one 2c's own measurements could not
That reading is not a null result about 2d. It is a positive statement about the method, and it
belongs in the record beside D1 rather than in a caveat under it.
It is stated as conditional on C1 and C2 landing inside their bands. If they do not, this
conclusion is NOT available and the null is reported as two candidate readings.

cost_expected.discriminator_probe: about 11 minutes: 16 points x 2 constructions at 20.65 and 10.89 seconds per point
cost_expected.rung: about 13.2 h at the signal-bearing rate, against 19.8 h left of the ceiling
cost_expected.priced_in: seconds, because iterations are the right unit for reproducibility and the wrong one for money

what_this_run_does_not_establish: Nothing here comes from real altimetry and no magnitude is quoted. The standing limitation is
unchanged: the spatial coherence of real altimetry optima has never been measured, and the
named closer is a spike on a real gridded product.
A null on this field is a statement about THIS construction at THIS difficulty. Its transfer to
a real field is exactly what the standing limitation says is unmeasured.
